meta.name: kingsfall
meta.prompt: Kingsfall: the dense capital of an old kingdom, packed onto one upland shelf. A fortified citadel of castle, keep, gatehouse, barbican and bastion stands inside a curtain-wall circuit with its barracks, armoury and arsenal in the bailey, and a guard line of watchtowers, bunker, pillbox, checkpoint and beacon tower holds the northern peak. East of the walls a faith quarter crowds thirteen houses of worship — cathedral, abbey, monastery, cloister, mosque and minaret, synagogue, pagoda, stupa, ziggurat and bell tower — around a great square. South-east the memorial vale is one continuous necropolis of mausoleum, tomb, cenotaph, war memorial, urn wall and pyre platform under a graveyard wall. West and south lie the fallen elder city on its megalith-strewn moor and a fantastical wood of wizards' towers, a dragon roost on the crag and a dwarven gate into the hillside.

root.label: Kingsfall and its quarters
root.note: A dense showcase of the old-kingdom register: citadel, faith quarter, memorial vale, elder ruins and a fantastical wood.
